thread:
Mira Chen: Hey team — Acclade (trial customer) just sent back their completed privacy questionnaire. A few live items: they want confirmation about non-prod data access, embeddings retention for PII, and whether we support customer-managed keys for Dedicated. Can someone help with concise answers I can paste back?
Tomas V: For non-prod access — standard policy is no customer data in shared non-prod clusters. We can run sanitized test logs, or spin a customer-dedicated dev namespace on Dedicated if they need a copy.
Priya Singh: +1 to Tomas. Also confirm contractual data segregation options. If they require non-prod with real data, we need a BYOK + audit scope change.
Alex R: For embeddings retention: default hosted embeddings are retained 30 days for quality monitoring, but we can opt-in to zero retention for strict customers. For Dedicated/Private, retention is controlled by customer config; we can set retention=0.
Deborah (Accl): thanks — can you confirm BYOK works with your Hosted API or only Dedicated? We prefer not to move infra yet.
Tomas V: BYOK is only available on Dedicated and Private today. Hosted supports encryption at rest with our keys; no customer-managed KMS on hosted.
Mira Chen: Noted. Deb — cc'ing Priya. If they must have BYOK we’ll propose a Dedicated pilot.
Deborah (Accl): Understood. One more: do you do pseudonymization for embeddings before storage?
Alex R: We do not apply automatic pseudonymization to model inputs; customers should redact PII in prompts. We can offer a post-ingest pipeline on Dedicated to hash or tokenise sensitive fields before storage as part of an engagement.
Priya Singh: I'll draft a short legal-friendly blurb: "Redwood does not process or alter customer-provided content; customers are responsible for redaction. For Dedicated/Private, we provide tooling and configurations to minimize retention and support BYOK and pseudonymization pipelines under a professional services agreement."
Mira Chen: Perfect. Tomas — can you drop a bullet list of tech options I can paste?
Tomas V: Sure —
- No real-customer data on shared non-prod
- Spin up customer dev namespace on Dedicated (isolated)
- Hosted: encryption at rest (provider-managed), retention options: 30d default, opt-out retention=0 for embeddings
- Dedicated/Private: BYOK (KMS/HSM), retention policy controls, optional pseudonymization pipeline (PS)
- Audit logs & key rotation support included with Dedicated enterprise plan
Priya Singh: I'm adding recommended contractual language and an escalation path if they require SOC2-in-scope non-prod.
Mira Chen: Great — I'll send Deb a summary and ask if they want a Dedicated pilot. Deb, want a quick call later today?
Deborah (Accl): Yes please — noon PT works. Also uploading their completed spreadsheet to the share.
upload-bot: file uploaded: "acclade_privacy_q1_answers.xlsx" (link: https://files.redwood/acclade_privacy_q1_answers.xlsx)
Mira Chen: Thanks! I'll circle back after the call with the one-pager and next-steps. :thumbsup:
